title: Senior Product Designer
description:
Vill du bygga framtidens nyhetsupplevelse tillsammans med oss?

Omni söker en Senior Product Designer som vill arbeta nära produkt, UX och utveckling för att skapa smartare, snabbare och bättre nyhetsupplevelser. Det här är en roll för dig som drivs av möjligheten att använda AI, stark produktdesign och ny teknik för att hjälpa människor att förstå vad som händer i världen – på ett sätt som är mer relevant, personligt och anpassat efter deras behov.

Hos oss får du arbeta med en av Sveriges starkaste nyhetsprodukter, i ett team där idéer snabbt kan bli verklighet. Om du vill jobba med nyheter på en plats där produktutveckling, användarupplevelse och AI på riktigt kan förändra hur människor konsumerar och förstår nyheter, är Omni där du vill vara.

Det här är en roll för dig som gillar att få saker att hända. Du är både strukturerad och hands-on, trivs i gränslandet mellan produkt, design och teknik och tycker om att lösa problem tillsammans med andra.

Om rollen

Du kommer att arbeta tätt tillsammans med Head of Product, Head of UX och utvecklingsteamet i det dagliga produktarbetet. Tjänsten är en projektanställning på 12 månader med god möjlighet till förlängning.

Rollen är bred och operativ med stort fokus på genomförande, problemlösning och samarbete.

Exempel på arbetsuppgifter:

  • Driva och projektleda mindre produktinitiativ tillsammans med andra teammedlemmar

  • Ta fram skisser och wireframes i Figma utifrån användarbehov, affärsbehov och tekniska möjligheter

  • Arbeta nära utvecklare för att förtydliga lösningar och säkerställa bra leverans

  • Vara med och definiera produktkrav, flöden och affärsregler

  • Översätta användarbehov och organisatoriska behov till konkreta produktlösningar

  • Hjälpa till att strukturera och driva arbete framåt

  • Bidra till utvecklingen av våra produkter, processer och arbetssätt

  • Utforska hur AI och ny teknik kan förbättra våra produkter och användarupplevelser

Vi tror att du

  • Är en stark problemlösare som gillar att ta ansvar och driva arbete framåt

  • Är operativ och trivs med att vara hands-on

  • Har erfarenhet av produktutveckling i digitala produkter och appar

  • Har gedigen erfarenhet av UX- och UI-arbete och är bekant med relevanta verktyg såsom Figma

  • Är van att arbeta nära utvecklare

  • Tänker ur ett helhetsperspektiv utifrån användarbehov, affärsmål och tekniska förutsättningar

  • Är nyfiken på AI, nya verktyg och modern produktutveckling

  • Kommunicerar tydligt och samarbetar bra med olika typer av kompetenser på svenska såväl engelska

Det är ett extra plus om du är intresserad av media, nyheter eller innehållsdrivna produkter.

Hos Omni

På Omni arbetar vi med produkter som används av flera hundratusentals människor varje vecka. Vi är ett litet och snabbfotat team där idéer snabbt kan bli verklighet och där produkt, UX och teknik arbetar nära varandra.

Hos Omni är alla medarbetares insatser, kunskap och idéer lika mycket värda. Det har skapat en stark, prestigelös och samarbetsdriven kultur där människor hjälper varandra och där bra idéer kan komma från vem som helst.

Entreprenörsandan är viktig för oss och bidrar till en utvecklande och stimulerande arbetsmiljö där det finns stort utrymme att testa nytt, ta initiativ och påverka både produkterna och hur vi arbetar framåt.

title: MuleSoft Integration Developer
description:
About the position

We are currently seeking an Integration Developer with strong expertise in MuleSoft Anypoint. Ideally, you also bring experience in platform and infrastructure management within AWS to support our growing Integration Solutions team. If you're passionate about building scalable integration systems, automating infrastructure, and working in a collaborative, open-minded team, this could be your next exciting challenge.

In this role, your main responsibility will be integration development within MuleSoft Anypoint platform. You will be a key member of the development team, as well as collaborate closely with the infrastructure team to manage the platform infrastructure, ensuring seamless system integration and robust infrastructure management.

Why this role matters

The Integration Solutions team is playing a key role in building a future-ready integration landscape. We have established a new Integration Competency Center (ICC) where you’ll be part of shaping the tools, processes, and infrastructure that support essential business operations across HR, Finance, Payroll, and more.

What you will do

  • Design, develop, test, and deploy scalable and secure integration solutions using MuleSoft.

  • Monitor and maintain platform performance with proactive incident and environment management.

  • Collaborate with both IT and business stakeholders to translate needs into practical, scalable solutions.

  • Work closely with Solution Architects and Integration Architects to continuously evolve our integration platform.

  • Actively contribute to a transparent and agile team environment.

Who you are

We’re looking for someone who thrives in a fast-moving environment and values honest collaboration. You might be a great match if you:

  • Are passionate about technology and creating well-functioning, scalable integration solutions.

  • Drive integrations from concept to production with a focus on automation, scalability, and continuous improvement.

  • A strong communicator who can explain complex technical concepts in simple terms.

  • Are pragmatic, proactive, and always looking for opportunities to improve tools and processes.

  • Enjoy working closely with others and helping build a collaborative team culture.

  • Embrace feedback and continuous learning as part of your daily work.

What you bring

We're looking for a strong mix of technical skills and collaborative mindset. Ideally, you have:

  • Hands-on experience designing and implementing integration solutions using tools like MuleSoft, APIs, and event-driven messaging.

  • Familiarity with CI/CD tools (like GitHub Actions) and infrastructure-as-code (e.g., Terraform) is helpful, especially when collaborating with the infra team, but not essential.

  • Strong problem-solving skills and a passion for creating maintainable, high-quality solutions.

  • The ability to work independently while contributing actively to an agile, team-driven environment.

Type of employment: Full-time, Permanent

Location: Stockholm / Oslo (hybrid), Krakow (remote)

Due to the vacation period, we will begin reviewing applications in August. Applications will be evaluated on an ongoing basis from that time, and the position may be filled before the application deadline.

Schibsted is the largest news provider in the Nordics, with brands such as VG, Aftonbladet, TV4, MTV, Aftenposten, Svenska Dagbladet, and Podme. Every day we inform, engage, and entertain millions of people across Sweden, Norway, and Finland. Schibsted is covered by a collective bargaining agreement.

Since 1839, trust has been our foundation. Our journalism empowers people, builds communities, and strengthens democracy – and innovation ensures we continue to protect that mission.

Our democracies depend on independent journalism. That’s our business.

title: Redaktionell utvecklings- och AI-chef sökes till Aftonbladet - tillsvidareanställning
description:
Vill du leda Aftonbladets AI- och utvecklingsresa?

Journalistiken förändras snabbt. AI skapar nya möjligheter att utveckla berättandet, förbättra användarupplevelsen och stärka vårt publicistiska uppdrag.

Nu söker vi en redaktionell utvecklings- och AI-chef som vill leda Aftonbladets utvecklings- och innovationsarbete in i nästa era. Som medlem i Aftonbladets ledningsgrupp rapporterar du till publisher och ansvarar för att driva utveckling, innovation och AI i nära samarbete med redaktion, produkt, teknik, data och affär. Du leder vårt redaktionella utvecklingsteam och har en nyckelroll i att omsätta ny teknik till bättre journalistik och nya möjligheter för Sveriges största nyhetsdestination.

Vi söker dig som

  • har erfarenhet av att leda utvecklings-, innovations- eller transformationsarbete

  • har dokumenterad erfarenhet av AI och digital utveckling i en redaktionell miljö

  • har erfarenhet av personalansvar och att bygga högpresterande team

  • förstår samspelet mellan journalistik, teknik och affär

  • är en strategisk ledare med stark genomförandekraft, ett plus är om du har erfarenhet från arbete i ledningsgrupp

Hos oss får du

  • påverka framtidens journalistik i en av Nordens ledande mediehus

  • arbeta i skärningspunkten mellan journalistik, teknologi och AI

  • vara med och forma nästa kapitel för Aftonbladet


Senast den 9 augusti 2026 behöver vi din ansökan. Om du har frågor kring rollen är du välkommen att mejla till sabina.lindstrom@schibsted.com med “Redaktionell utvecklingschef” som rubrik. För fackliga frågor kontakta Konrad Cronsioe (SJF) konrad.cronsioe@schibsted.com.

Vi hoppas att du också får njuta av sommaren! Hos oss innebär semesterperioden att svarstiderna kan vara lite längre än vanligt. Tack för att du har tålamod – vi ser fram emot att höra från dig.

Tjänsten är en tillsvidareanställning med tillträde enligt överenskommelse (6 månaders provanställning tillämpas).

Vi arbetar med löpande urval och tjänsten kan komma att tillsättas innan sista ansökningsdagen.

Välkommen med din ansökan!

title: Backend Developer – AI Platform & Editorial Tools
description:
Om Omni

Omni har funnits på den svenska mediemarknaden sedan november 2013 och är ett självständigt bolag inom Schibsted. Vi är Sveriges femte största nyhetstjänst med runt 800 000 unika läsare och har flera gånger utsetts till Sveriges bästa nyhetstjänst.

Mediebranschen genomgår just nu en historisk förändring. AI förändrar hur journalistik produceras, organiseras och konsumeras. På Omni bygger vi nästa generations AI-drivna plattform och verktyg för nyhetsredaktioner – teknik som ska ge journalister helt nya möjligheter och lägga grunden för framtidens nyhetsupplevelser.

Nu söker vi en backendutvecklare som vill vara med och bygga den tekniska plattformen bakom den utvecklingen.

Rollen

Du blir en del av ett litet, tvärfunktionellt team som bygger helt nya AI-drivna produkter och redaktionella verktyg. Här handlar arbetet inte om att förvalta befintliga system, utan om att utforska vad som blir möjligt när AI blir en självklar del av både utveckling och journalistik.

Du bygger arkitektur, API:er, integrationer och intelligenta arbetsflöden som omsätter nya AI-möjligheter till robusta produkter. Du arbetar nära produkt och design, äger din kod hela vägen till drift och trivs i ett högt tempo där idéer snabbt blir verklighet.

Här får du chansen att kliva in i ett sammansvetsat, prestigelöst team med stort eget ansvar och ett öppet klimat för nya idéer. Eftersom vi bygger nytt snarare än förvaltar befintliga system behöver du trivas med hög autonomi, snabba omställningar och en vardag där alla svar inte finns från början.

Det här är en projektanställning på 12 månader med goda möjligheter till förlängning.

Vad du gör

  • Utvecklar och arkitekterar API:er, backendtjänster och integrationer för våra AI-drivna produkter.

  • Bygger och förbättrar event-drivna flöden för databehandling, automatisering och intelligenta arbetsflöden.

  • Arbetar med LLM-baserade pipelines och hjälper till att göra dem tillförlitliga i produktion.

  • Äger din kod hela vägen – från utveckling och test till deployment och drift.

  • Är med och bygger den tekniska plattform som ska möjliggöra framtidens verktyg för nyhetsredaktioner.

Vår stack

Du behöver inte vara bekant med allt från dag ett, men det här är vad du jobbar med:

  • Backend: Node.js med TypeScript, Hono, tRPC, Zod, Drizzle ORM

  • Data: PostgreSQL, Neo4j, Redis

  • AI: LLM-klienter och evals för kvalitetsmätning

  • Event/orkestrering: AWS SQS, event-drivna workflows och queue handlers

  • Frontend (vid behov): React, React Router, TanStack Query

  • Infrastruktur: AWS, Kubernetes, GitHub Actions, Docker och GitOps (ArgoCD)

Utvecklingsverktyg som Claude Code och Codex är en hörnsten i vårt dagliga arbete och gör det möjligt för oss att bygga snabbare och smartare. Du behöver inte vara expert, men du har praktisk erfarenhet av AI-verktyg och en tydlig drivkraft att utforska hur de förändrar produktutveckling.

Vi tror att du

  • Har gedigen erfarenhet av backendutveckling, systemarkitektur och API-design.

  • Är van att bygga och driftsätta produktionskritiska system.

  • Har ett helhetsperspektiv på systemutveckling och gillar att lösa komplexa tekniska problem.

  • Har erfarenhet av AI, LLM:er och moderna utvecklingsverktyg.

  • Är en prestigelös lagspelare som uppskattar code reviews och pragmatiska lösningar.

  • Trivs i ett högt tempo där nya idéer snabbt blir produkter.

  • Kommunicerar obehindrat på svenska och engelska.

Det är ett plus om du även är bekväm i frontend, men tyngdpunkten ligger på backend.

Hur vi jobbar

Du blir en del av ett litet, sammansvetsat och snabbfotat team där vi värdesätter nyfikenhet, samarbete och ett högt tekniskt kunnande. Vi tror på pragmatiska lösningar, rak kommunikation och stort eget ansvar. Code reviews och kunskapsdelning är en självklar del av vårt arbetssätt.

Omni tillämpar en hybrid arbetsmodell med utgångspunkt från vårt Stockholmskontor. Samtidigt har vi kollegor i bland annat Oslo, Gdansk och Marbella, och vi värnar om en flexibel arbetsvardag med god balans mellan arbete och fritid.

title: Senior Data Engineer in Data Product Engineering
description:
Join the Data & AI journey at Schibsted Media

Data and AI are becoming increasingly important in how we build better products, support smarter decisions, and create value across Schibsted Media. We are looking for a Senior Data Engineer who wants to help shape reliable, scalable, and well-governed data products used across our media brands.

In this role, you will work in the intersection of data engineering, analytics engineering, and platform thinking. You will help us build trusted data models, improve how we work with data pipelines, and guide technical direction for a team working closely with stakeholders across Finance, HR, Product, Subscription, and other data & AI teams.

You will join the Data & AI organization in the Data Product Engineering team, where we build data capabilities that help teams across Schibsted Media make better decisions, create trusted data products, and enable future AI use cases.

About the role

We are looking for someone who can be both hands-on and guiding. You do not need to be the loudest person in the room, but you should be able to create clarity, make pragmatic technical decisions, and help other engineers grow.

You will play a key role in shaping how we build data as a product. This includes creating data models that are reliable, well-documented, and designed for real use cases, not just pipelines that move data.

As a senior member of the team, you will also help create good engineering practices, mentor more junior engineers, and collaborate closely with adjacent teams working on data platforms and shared tooling.

As part of a newly formed team of Data / Analytics Engineers, you'll have the opportunity to influence how we work, shape our engineering culture, and make a real impact from day one. We're now looking for 2–3 more engineers to join us on the journey.

What you will do

  • Collaborate closely with stakeholders to understand needs, clarify tradeoffs, and deliver pragmatic solutions

  • Design, build, and maintain robust data pipelines using technologies such as Snowflake, dbt, and Airflow

  • Develop scalable and maintainable data models that support analytics, reporting, and AI use cases

  • Help define best practices for data modeling, transformation, testing, documentation, and governance

  • Mentor junior engineers and support the team in making good technical decisions

  • Work with adjacent Data & AI teams to align on platform capabilities, standards, and shared ways of working

  • Improve reliability, performance, cost-efficiency, and scalability of our data solutions

  • Contribute to a culture of ownership, learning, and continuous improvement

What we are looking for

Must have

  • Solid experience as a Data Engineer or similar role

  • Strong SQL skills and good understanding of data warehousing concepts

  • Experience with data modeling and building data products for analytics or reporting

  • Experience with modern data transformation and orchestration tools (e.g. dbt, Airflow or similar)

  • Ability to take ownership and make pragmatic technical decisions in ambiguous and evolving environments

  • Strong communication skills and ability to work with both technical and non-technical stakeholders. English is our main working language.

  • Collaborative mindset and ability to work well across teams

Nice to have

  • Experience with Python or scripting for data engineering workflows

  • Experience with CI/CD, GitOps, and version control best practices

  • Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, GCP, or Azure

  • Experience with data quality, observability, governance, or access control

  • Experience as a senior engineer in a cross-functional environment

Why join us?

  • High ownership and influence in shaping technical direction and ways of working

  • Opportunity to shape trusted data products with real impact across Schibsted Media

  • Flexible working hours and hybrid work options with strong trust and autonomy

  • International environment with offices in Oslo, Stockholm, and Krakow

  • Strong learning culture with learning budget and active engineering & AI communities

  • Access to Schibsted’s media products, including premium news and podcasts

About you

You enjoy turning messy problems into clear, maintainable solutions. You care about technical quality, but you also understand that good engineering is about tradeoffs, communication, and delivering value.

You are comfortable working in an environment where not everything is fully defined yet. You help create structure, bring others along, and make the team better through your technical judgment and collaboration.

When you apply, we'd love to get to know the real you. We value authentic applications and are much more interested in your own thoughts, experiences, and motivations than polished AI-generated content.

If you want to help build trusted data products that enable better decisions and future AI capabilities across Schibsted Media, we would love to hear from you.

title: Senior Backend Developer – Omni Core Platform
description:
Om Omni

Omni har funnits på den svenska mediemarknaden sedan november 2013 och är ett självständigt bolag inom Schibsted. Vi är Sveriges femte största nyhetstjänst med runt 800 000 unika läsare och har flera gånger utsetts till Sveriges bästa nyhetstjänst. Vår huvudplattform är mobilen, men vi har också många läsare på desktop och surfplatta.

Varje dag använder hundratusentals människor Omni för att förstå vad som händer i världen. Bakom upplevelsen finns en teknisk plattform som måste vara snabb, stabil och skalbar – dygnet runt.

Hos oss arbetar Tech, redaktion och produkt nära varandra. AI och agentiska kodverktyg är en naturlig del av hur vi utvecklar, testar och levererar mjukvara. Nu söker vi en senior backendutvecklare som vill vara med och vidareutveckla Omnis kärnplattform.

Rollen

Du blir en del av vårt ordinarie utvecklingsteam på tio personer och får en central roll i att utveckla systemen bakom en av Sveriges starkaste nyhetstjänster. Du bygger backendtjänster, API:er och integrationer, utvecklar arkitekturen och ser till att våra system fungerar stabilt i produktion.

Du har ett arkitektperspektiv, vågar utmana hur vi gör saker idag och är lika hemma i koden som i pipelinen som tar den till produktion. DevOps är inte någon annans problem för dig – det är en naturlig del av hur du bygger.

Det här är en projektanställning på 12 månader med goda möjligheter till förlängning.

Vad du gör

  • Designar och bygger skalbara backendtjänster, API:er och integrationer som driver en av Sveriges starkaste nyhetsprodukter.

  • Sätter teknisk riktning och arkitektur i din domän, och utmanar status quo när det behövs.

  • Äger dina tjänster i drift: bygger, deployar och håller dem stabila i produktion.

  • Jobbar med vårt event-drivna flöde: ingestion, parsning, köer och pipelines.

  • Förbättrar hur vi levererar kod, från CI/CD och containrar till observability.

  • Granskar kod, delar kunskap och höjer ribban i teamet.

Vår stack

Du behöver inte ha allt från dag ett, men det här är vad du jobbar med:

  • Backend: Node.js med TypeScript, Hono och Express, tRPC, Zod, Drizzle

  • Data: PostgreSQL, Redis

  • Event/integration: AWS SQS/SNS, S3

  • Infra & drift: AWS (EKS, RDS, S3, SQS/SNS), Kubernetes, Terraform, ArgoCD, Helm

  • Leverans: GitHub Actions, Docker, GitOps, Grafana för observability

  • Arbetssätt: pnpm/Turborepo-monorepos, Biome, Vitest, Playwright, MSW

Frontend i React och Next.js finns nära, och det är ett plus om du kan röra dig dit när det behövs, men tyngdpunkten i rollen är backend och drift.

Vi använder agentiska kodverktyg som Claude Code och Codex i det dagliga utvecklingsarbetet. Du behöver inte vara expert från start, men du är nyfiken på hur AI kan göra utveckling snabbare och bättre – och vill fortsätta utvecklas tillsammans med oss.

Vi tror att du

  • Har gedigen backenderfarenhet inom arkitektur, API:er och integrationer, och har levererat produktionsdugliga system.

  • Är stark på DevOps: CI/CD, containrar, Kubernetes och infrastruktur som kod.

  • Har ett arkitektperspektiv och gillar att sätta teknisk riktning och förbättra plattformar över tid.

  • Är prestigelös och pragmatisk, bryr dig mer om att lösa problemet än om att få cred.

  • Är nyfiken på AI och moderna utvecklingsverktyg.

  • Delar gärna med dig och lyfter teamet genom code reviews och kunskapsdelning.

  • Kommunicerar tydligt på svenska och engelska.

Det är ett plus om du också är bekväm i frontend, men det är backend och drift vi söker.

Hur vi jobbar

Som en del av vårt kompakta och snabbrörliga team får du en miljö där varje röst väger tungt. Vi lever efter en prestigelös och pragmatisk kultur som vilar på genuint samarbete. Genom kontinuerliga code reviews främjar vi både kvalitetssäkring och aktiv kunskapsspridning. Vi prioriterar robusta och okomplicerade lösningar, samtidigt som vi drivs av en passion för att utforska nya tekniker som kan lyfta vår produkt ytterligare.

Vi har en hybrid arbetsmiljö med kontor i Stockholm där majoriteten av teamet sitter, och kollegor i Oslo och Gdansk. Vi är flexibla kring distans kontra kontor, och du kan räkna med en sund balans mellan jobb och fritid.

title: Data Engineer
description:
Join the Data & AI journey at Schibsted Media

Data and AI are becoming increasingly important in how we build better products, support smarter decisions, and create value across Schibsted Media.

We're looking for a Data Engineer to join our Data Infrastructure team and help build the shared data platform that powers analytics and AI across Schibsted Media. Our team enables data teams to build trusted, scalable, and well-governed data products.

In this role, you will work at the intersection of data engineering and platform engineering. You'll help improve our data platform while also contributing to trusted data models, modern data pipelines, and engineering practices used across the organization. You will join the Data & AI organization, where we build data capabilities that help teams across Schibsted Media make better decisions, create trusted data products, and enable future AI use cases.

About the role

We're looking for someone with 4+ years of experience who enjoys building solid data solutions while improving the shared data platform that enables teams across Schibsted Media.

You'll work with technologies such as Snowflake, dbt, Airflow, and Python to develop shared tooling, maintain platform capabilities, and contribute to modern data engineering practices.

You'll also help deploy and manage cloud infrastructure, automate operational tasks, and continuously improve the reliability and scalability of our platform. While prior infrastructure experience is a plus, we're looking for someone who is eager to learn and grow in this area.

What you'll do

  • Collaborate with Data & AI teams to understand platform needs and deliver scalable data solutions

  • Design, build, and improve shared data platform capabilities, developer tooling, data pipelines, and automation using technologies such as Snowflake, dbt, Airflow, and Python

  • Support and evolve our Privacy Compliance Platform, helping enable secure, compliant, and governed access to data across Schibsted Media

  • Deploy, maintain, and improve cloud infrastructure using Infrastructure as Code and modern automation practices

  • Improve reliability, observability, performance, cost-efficiency, and scalability of our data platform

  • Develop reusable templates, tooling, and documentation that enable self-service across Data & AI teams

  • Develop maintainable data models that support analytics, reporting, and AI use cases

  • Contribute to good practices for data modeling, transformation, testing, documentation, and governance

  • Participate in code reviews, technical discussions, and continuous improvement of our ways of working

  • Contribute to a culture of ownership, learning, and collaboration

What we're looking for

Must have

  • 4+ years of experience as a Data Engineer or similar role

  • Strong SQL skills and a good understanding of modern data warehousing concepts

  • Experience building data pipelines and working with orchestration tools such as Airflow or similar

  • Hands-on experience with dbt and modern data transformation practices

  • Experience with Python for data engineering or automation

  • Experience with Git and modern software engineering practices

  • Ability to take ownership of tasks and deliver maintainable solutions

  • Good communication skills and ability to work with both technical and non-technical stakeholders. English is our main working language.

  • Collaborative mindset and willingness to learn from and contribute to the team

Nice to have

  • Experience with software engineering practices such as automated testing, CI/CD, and code review workflows

  • Experience with Snowflake or similar cloud data platforms

  • Experience with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform or similar)

  • Experience with AWS, GCP, or Azure

  • Interest in data quality, observability, governance, or platform engineering

Why join us?

  • Build the platform that enables data and AI across Schibsted Media

  • Work with modern technologies and experienced engineers across multiple teams

  • Flexible working hours and hybrid work options with strong trust and autonomy

  • International environment with offices in Oslo, Stockholm, and Krakow

  • Strong learning culture with learning budget and active engineering & AI communities

  • Access to Schibsted's premium media products, including news and podcasts

About you

You enjoy turning technical challenges into simple, maintainable solutions. You're passionate about improving the developer experience and building reusable solutions that help other engineers move faster. You care about building reliable systems, but also understand that great engineering is about collaboration, continuous improvement, and enabling others to succeed.

You're curious, take ownership of your work, and enjoy helping build the platform that supports trusted data products across Schibsted Media.

title: Reporter till 200 sekunder
description:
Vill du göra journalistik som gör skillnad - och vara med och utveckla hur den berättas?
200 sekunder är Aftonbladets granskande program som avslöjar maktmissbruk, synar orättvisor och berättar med kraft genom video. Nu söker vi en reporter som vill vara med och utveckla nästa generation granskande journalistik.

Du är en nyfiken och envis reporter som drivs av att hitta berättelser andra missar. Du gillar att gräva, ifrågasätta och följa spåren hela vägen. Samtidigt är du nyfiken på hur ny teknik kan göra journalistiken ännu bättre – från AI-stödd research och analys till nya sätt att berätta med onlinevideo.

Vi tror att du:

  • har erfarenhet av granskande eller undersökande journalistik

  • är skicklig på research, källarbete och att hantera stora mängder information

  • ser AI och andra nya tekniska verktyg som en naturlig del av den journalistiska verktygslådan och vill vara med och utforska hur de kan användas på ett ansvarsfullt sätt i granskande journalistik

  • har ett starkt journalistiskt berättande och gärna erfarenhet av videojournalistik eller andra digitala berättarformat

  • är nyfiken, uthållig och gillar att samarbeta med reportrar, fotografer, redigerare och utvecklare.

Hos oss får du arbeta i en kreativ och ambitiös miljö där idéer snabbt kan bli verklighet. Vi satsar på undersökande journalistik och vill ligga i framkant – både journalistiskt och tekniskt. Därför söker vi dig som vill vara med och utveckla nya metoder för research, analys och berättande med hjälp av AI, data och digitala format.

Vi erbjuder ett jobb där du får stora möjligheter att utvecklas, testa nya arbetssätt och göra journalistik som får genomslag och gör skillnad.

Låter det som du? Då vill vi gärna höra från dig!

Kontakt
Vid frågor om rollen, kontakta Jonathan Jeppsson, jonathan.jeppsson@aftonbladet.se. För fackliga frågor, kontakta Cecilia Vaccari, cecilia.vaccari@aftonbladet.se

Aftonbladet är svenska folkets primära nyhetskälla som varje dag når omkring 3,7 miljoner läsare och tittare, via mobila plattformar, webben, online video och som papperstidning. 250 000 svenskar är i dag digitala prenumeranter på Aftonbladet Plus. Varje dygn publiceras omkring 500 artiklar, men också ett stort antal videoinslag och tv-program.

Aftonbladet bevakar Sverige och världen och är ofta på plats och rapporterar direkt vid stora nyhetshändelser. Breaking News är en av de bärande delarna i vår journalistik och online video en integrerad del av nyhetsredaktionen. Stor vikt läggs också vid daglig agenda-journalistik, granskningar och gräv, underhållning, sport och livsstils-journalistik.

Tidningen grundades 1830 av Lars Johan Hierta och ägs i dag av den norska mediekoncernen Schibsted (91 procent) och Landsorganisationen, LO, (9 procent). Vi är anslutna till kollektivavtal.

title: Director Group Financial Reporting
description:
Schibsted’s finance function is now embarking on an ambitious transformation journey, following the acquisitions of TV4 in Sweden and MTV in Finland. We are building a modern, scalable, and insight-driven finance organization to support the largest media group in the Nordics.

To help us achieve this, we are looking for an experienced finance leader to join us as Director Group Financial Reporting.

A Leadership Role at the Core of Schibsted’s Transformation

Reporting to the Group CFO, you will lead the Group Financial Reporting and Finance Operations organization, own the end-to-end accounting and reporting framework, and serve as a trusted partner to senior stakeholders. You will play a key role in harmonizing finance processes, governance and reporting across the Group, while driving the transformation of a modern, scalable and insight-driven finance function. Throug high-quality financial data, trusted reporting and robust governance, you will enable better decision-making, stronger control and greater business insight across the Group.

Key Responsibilities

• Own the consolidation and reporting framework, ensuring quality and consistency in consolidated financial reporting, and sustainability reporting (IFRS)

• Act as senior advisor on complex accounting matters and significant transactions

• Build and strengthen governance frameworks, internal controls, and assurance readiness

• Drive standardization and automation across finance processes

• Serve as the primary finance interface towards the Audit Committee and external auditors

• Lead and develop finance leaders and specialists across Group Financial Reporting and Finance Operations

• Contribute actively to building a scalable, future-ready finance function

Who We Are Looking For
We are looking for a leader who combines technical credibility, strategic thinking and organizational leadership, with the ability to lead through leaders and drive meaningful change.

You bring:

• Proven leadership experience across organizational boundaries and through leaders

• Extensive experience in Group Accounting, Consolidation and Financial Reporting in a multinational environment

• Strong IFRS expertise and deep understanding of end-to-end finance processes

• Experience leading transformation, process improvement and organizational change in complex environments

• High integrity, sound judgement, and the confidence to challenge constructively

• Excellent communication skills and fluency in English and either Norwegian or Swedish

Why Schibsted?
You will work alongside talented colleagues, influence decisions at the highest levels, and play a central role in shaping the future of finance within one of the Nordics’ most influential media groups.

Schibsted is partnering with Korn Ferry in this recruitment process, initiated in August. Questions can be directed to peter.klokk@kornferry.com

By applying, you confirm that your application and personal data may be shared with Korn Ferry for evaluation purposes. For more information, please refer to Schibsted’s Privacy Notice.

Schibsted is an owner of editorial media and the largest news provider in the Nordics. With brands such as VG, Aftonbladet, TV4, MTV, Aftenposten, Svenska Dagbladet, and Podme, we inform, engage, and entertain millions of people across Sweden, Norway, and Finland every day.

Trust has been our foundation since 1839, when Christian Schibsted founded a small printing business in Oslo. For nearly two centuries, our journalism has empowered people, built communities, exposed abuses of power, and strengthened democracies. Schibsted is covered by a collective bargaining agreement.

From the very beginning, we have embraced innovation and challenged the status quo. We believe that curiosity, creativity, and the exploration of new technologies are essential to protecting our core mission.

Our democracies depend on independent journalism. That’s our business.

title: Engineering Manager
description:
Are you an engineering leader who enjoys creating clarity, improving engineering effectiveness, and helping engineers deliver with confidence? Do you care about iOS, Android, and Web capability as much as you care about people leadership? If so, we’d love to hear from you.

As a part of our vision to enrich people’s lives through stories, we are strengthening the engineering foundation behind listener and subscriber experience by hiring an Engineering Manager to lead our iOS, Android, and Web engineers. In this role, you will help create the clarity, capability, and delivery conditions behind high-quality user-facing product development.

This is a great opportunity to increase your impact at a fast-moving audio company backed by Schibsted Media, and to work with teams that combine quality engineering, product thinking, and care for the listener experience.

What you'll do

  • Lead, support, and develop a distributed group of iOS, Android, and Web engineers through coaching, feedback, growth planning, and clear role expectations.

  • Foster an inclusive and accountable environment where employees and consultants across locations have context and support.

  • Maintain visibility of capability, ownership, staffing needs, consultant dependency, and succession risks across the client-side engineering domain.

  • Support engineering strategy execution by partnering with product and tech leadership.

  • Surface technical debt, quality risks, release risks, infrastructure constraints, and operational needs early to enable informed decisions.

  • Strengthen engineering standards around maintainability, observability, security, performance, and operational excellence.

  • Help teams balance platform-specific excellence with cross-platform alignment where it improves user experience, delivery efficiency, quality, or maintainability.

What You Bring

You combine people leadership with the technical understanding needed to support iOS, Android, Web, and user-facing product trade-offs. You create clarity in complex environments and help teams improve how they work.

  • Experience leading, coaching, mentoring or developing engineers.

  • Experience working with distributed or hybrid engineering teams. Previous management experience in this setup is a plus.

  • Understanding of modern software delivery practices and the quality needs of user-facing products.

  • Understanding of mobile release processes and the quality assurance needs of mobile releases.

  • Ability to balance engineering standards with team autonomy.

  • Ability to explain engineering trade-offs, risks, and constraints clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders.

  • Clear communication and relationship-building skills.

  • Cost-conscious approach to staffing, tooling, infrastructure, and technical decisions.

  • Professional-level English communication skills. Swedish is beneficial.

Bonus points if you have

  • Experience leading mixed teams of employees and consultants.

  • Experience working with iOS, Android, Web, frontend, mobile release processes, web conversion flows, playback or listening experiences, experimentation, design systems, accessibility, or app-store release cycles.

  • Experience with subscription, media, audio, video, consumer products, or multi-market organisations.

  • Experience improving release confidence, production quality signals, test strategy, analytics instrumentation, frontend performance, or developer experience.

  • Experience supporting AI-assisted engineering, experimentation capability, or engineering productivity improvements.

Why Join Podme?

At Podme, we believe in the power of audio stories to inform, entertain, and inspire. Backed by Schibsted, one of the Nordics’ leading media groups, we’re on a mission to deliver the best of podcasting and audiobooks to listeners across Sweden, Norway, and Finland.

  • Join a growing platform with a loyal and expanding user base.

  • Lead the iOS, Android, and Web engineering competence domain behind the product surfaces where listeners and subscribers experience Podme most directly.

  • Work closely with product, technology, and business stakeholders on problems that affect core listener and subscriber journeys.

  • Hybrid setup based in Krakow, with collaboration across Poland, Sweden, and Bosnia

  • Travel to Krakow occasionally, approximately 1-2 times per year

  • Great benefits through Schibsted and Podme

  • Free access to premium Podme content and audiobooks

Help us build the engineering foundation behind the Nordic audio experience.

Your next great challenge starts here.

Apply now and let’s build something great together.

Please note that due to the summer vacation period, we will start reviewing applications and contacting candidates from the beginning of August. Thank you for your patience.

About Podme

Podme is the place for premium podcasts and audiobooks. With over 350,000 paying subscribers, we’re available in Sweden, Norway, and Finland, and part of Schibsted Media since 2021.

Our vision is to enrich people’s lives through stories, which embodies our core belief in the power of narratives to bring joy, meaning, and connection to individuals. We strive to create effortless and habit-forming audio and product experiences that resonate with the listener and add value in their everyday lives.

We’re a friendly and passionate team of +80 people, here to make listening effortless, inspiring, and part of everyday life. Backed by Schibsted Media, the largest media group in Scandinavia, we are now on a growth journey which requires us to strengthen the engineering foundation needed to support product complexity, reliability, and sustainable delivery.

title: Consent & Privacy Technology Specialist
description:
About Schibsted

Schibsted is a leading digital media company in the Nordics, reaching millions of users every day through trusted news brands and digital services. Our mission is to empower people through news, entertainment and sports powered by innovation and technology. As the digital landscape evolves, we are investing heavily in first-party data, personalization, and privacy-first user experiences that build trust and long-term relationships with our audiences.

The Role

We are looking for a Consent & Privacy Technology Specialist to join our User Foundation. In this role, you will own and evolve the consent and privacy technology ecosystem that powers our data-driven products, advertising solutions, and personalized experiences across Schibsted's portfolio of media brands.

You will play a critical role in ensuring that user consent is collected, managed, and activated in a compliant, scalable, and user-centric way. Working closely with Product, Engineering, Data, Legal, Privacy, Analytics, and Commercial teams, you will translate privacy regulations into practical technical implementations that enable responsible innovation.

This is an opportunity to shape how millions of users interact with privacy choices while helping Schibsted strengthen trust, transparency, and sustainable growth.

What You'll Do

  • Support and manage Schibsted's consent management platform and related privacy technologies.

  • Design, implement, and optimize end-to-end consent signal flows across websites, apps, advertising systems, and data platforms.

  • Translate GDPR, ePrivacy, and other regulatory requirements into scalable technical solutions and consent logic.

  • Partner with Product, Engineering, Legal, and Data teams to ensure privacy-by-design principles are embedded into new initiatives.

  • Drive improvements in consent collection, consent quality, and user transparency.

  • Support integration of consent signals into personalization, analytics, advertising, and customer data platforms.

  • Monitor industry developments, browser changes, and privacy technology trends, identifying opportunities and risks for Schibsted.

  • Act as a subject matter expert on consent and privacy technology across the organization.

What We're Looking For

  • Hands-on experience working with Consent Management Platforms (CMPs), such as OneTrust, Didomi, Sourcepoint, Usercentrics, or similar solutions.

  • Strong understanding of digital advertising and marketing technology ecosystems, including web tracking, identity, audience activation, and measurement.

  • Experience translating privacy and regulatory requirements into technical requirements

  • Familiarity with GDPR, ePrivacy regulations, and privacy-first data practices.

  • Knowledge of the IAB TCF, consent signalling standard like Google Consent Mode, and tracking technologies.

  • Proven ability to collaborate effectively across technical, product, commercial, and legal stakeholders.

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a pragmatic mindset.

Nice to Have

  • Basic knowledge or willingness to learn JavaScript for CMP template updates

  • Experience from digital media, publishing, ad tech, marktech, or subscription businesses.

  • Experience working with first-party data strategies and personalization platforms.

  • Experience working with data platforms, tagging frameworks, analytics solutions, or customer data infrastructure.

Location

Where: Stockholm, Sweden or Krakow, Poland

Hybrid: 50/ 50 remote / office policy

Why Join Schibsted?

At Schibsted, you'll work on products that matter to society while helping shape the future of digital experiences. You'll collaborate with talented colleagues across the Nordics and Poland and have the opportunity to influence how trusted media brands balance personalization, advertising, and user trust at scale.

We believe diverse perspectives make us stronger. If you're excited about this role but don't meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. Curiosity, initiative, and a willingness to learn are qualities we value highly.

title: Aftonbladet söker breakingchef
description:
Aftonbladet söker breakingchef


Aftonbladets breakingdesk är bäst i Sverige, snabbast på nyheter och levererar den sajt som har flest läsare varje dag.
Nu söker vi dig som vill leda arbetet på dagtid, med en grupp reportrar som har fokus på snabba nyheter, fältarbete och egna vinklar.
Dokumenterad erfarenhet av breakingjournalistik, att vinna de svåra nyhetsmatcherna och arbetsleda fram kreativa vinklar är meriterande.
I den här rollen förväntas du prioritera i realtid och coacha medarbetarna fram till bra och snabba lösningar för det uppdrag som ligger framför dem.
En vilja att förnya arbetssätt och berättande är ett plus i kanten.

Som journalist är du modig, kreativ, vass och här mycket intresserad av vad som händer i Sverige och världen, inom alla olika ämnesområden.
Som ledare är du kommunikativ, inkluderande, bra på feedback och att bygga lag.

I tjänsten ingår självständiga publicistiska bedömningar, vilket betyder att vi söker någon som har erfarenhet av att ha fattat pressetiska beslut.
Specialkunskaper, annorlunda erfarenheter och annan bakgrund än den som är vanlig bland journalister är meriterande.
Erfarenhet av onlinejournalistik ser vi som en god merit.

Den här tjänsten innebär skiftgång på dagtid, med tidiga morgnar och jobb två helger i månaden.

Tillträde sker enligt överenskommelse och rekryteringsprocessen startar i augusti.

Vad vi kan erbjuda?

  • En stimulerande arbetsplats där du når en miljonpublik.

  • Kunniga, smarta och drivna kollegor och en trevlig arbetsmiljö

  • Krävande och erfarna chefer som får dig att utvecklas varje dag.

  • Engagerad publik som hjälper oss att bli bättre.


Frågor om tjänsten? Kontakta Hanna Olsson Berg: hanna.olsson@aftonbladet.se

Fackliga frågor besvaras av Cecilia Vaccari: cecilia.vaccari@aftonbladet.se

title: Senior Product Designer
description:
Are you a product designer shaping best-in-class podcast experiences?

What if your design work didn’t just improve interfaces, but changed how people build habits and keep coming back?

At Podme, success isn’t measured by what we ship. It’s measured by whether people return, build habits, and stay. That means design isn’t just about screens it’s about helping users succeed in ways that drive real business outcomes.

We’re looking for a Senior Product Designer (UX) who wants to design at that level of impact.

This is not a role for someone who polishes interfaces after decisions are already made.

This is a role for someone who helps shape what gets built, by understanding user behavior, identifying the right problems, and designing experiences that create meaningful outcomes for both listeners and the business.

At Podme, great design helps people discover content they love, continue listening effortlessly, and build habits around premium podcasts and audio experiences.

  • Frame product opportunities through user behavior, motivation, and outcomes

  • Help users discover content they genuinely care about

  • Make continuation feel effortless across moments and devices

  • Create clear and coherent journeys across listening and discovery

  • Collaborate with stakeholders and subject matter experts to understand opportunities and constraints

  • Turn insights into clear product direction, hypotheses, and design principles

  • Focus on user outcomes before interface solutions

You’ll:

  • Prototype and validate ideas early

  • Ensure experiences are scalable, feasible, and impactful

Together, you share accountability for user outcomes, not just delivery.

What success looks like

  • Teams focus on solving the right problems, not just shipping more features

  • You turn research and behavioral insights into clear product direction

  • The experiences you design consistently increase repeat listening and habit formation

  • You become a trusted partner in shaping product strategy and experience direction

  • You help strengthen a product culture where design is deeply connected to business impact

  • You are comfortable working with ambiguity and helping shape direction

  • You use research and data to inform and challenge decisions

  • You collaborate naturally across disciplines and involve stakeholders early

  • You care deeply about user outcomes, product quality, and business impact

Bonus points if you have

title: Android Developer

title: Spontanansökan: Jobba med oss på Omni
description:
Vill du vara en del av Sveriges bästa redaktion?

Omni har flera gånger prisats som Sveriges bästa nyhetstjänst och har både förändrat hur människor läser nyheter och moderniserat den redaktionella processen. Redaktörerna som jobbar hos oss är Sveriges bästa – och vi söker ständigt nya stjärnor!

Redaktör, Omni

Vi söker ständigt nya medarbetare till både längre vikariat och tillsvidaretjänster. Skicka in en ansökan och berätta varför just du skulle passa hos oss!

title: Product Manager, Ad Solutions
description:
The company

Schibsted is the largest news provider in the Nordics, with brands such as VG, Aftonbladet, TV4, MTV, Aftenposten, Svenska Dagbladet, and Podme. Every day we inform, engage, and entertain millions of people across Sweden, Norway, and Finland.

Since 1839, trust has been our foundation. Our journalism empowers people, builds communities, and strengthens democracy – and innovation ensures we continue to protect that mission.

Our democracies depend on independent journalism. That’s our business.

Strategic purpose of the role

As Product Manager, Ad Solutions, you are responsible for driving the development and evolution of key areas within Admarket — Schibsted’s advertising platform. You work closely with the Head of Product to shape priorities and ensure meaningful progress within your product domain.

You translate strategic direction into clear initiatives, structured product work, and measurable outcomes. The role balances discovery and delivery, ensuring that product decisions create real user and business value while supporting the long-term development of the platform.

You take ownership of your product area and are responsible for driving initiatives from discovery through execution.

Role tasks and responsibilities

  • Translate strategic objectives into prioritised initiatives and actionable plans

  • Define key success metrics and ensure transparent follow-up on adoption, performance, and business impact

  • Lead structured discovery to validate problems and opportunities

  • Manage backlog and prioritisation based on business value, impact, and feasibility

  • Drive clarity in scope, trade-offs, and expectations across stakeholders

  • Partner closely with Engineering and UX to ensure focused and efficient delivery

  • Identify opportunities to improve, simplify, and scale workflows within your area

  • Communicate product decisions and rationale clearly to relevant stakeholders

  • Proactively explore new technologies and ways of working, including practical experimentation with emerging tools to improve speed, quality, and impact

  • Stay informed about relevant market and competitor developments to challenge assumptions and identify opportunities for improvement

Special complexity / challenges in the role

  • Operating in a complex platform where product decisions can impact multiple workflows, systems, and teams

  • Balancing short-term delivery needs with long-term structural improvements

  • Prioritising effectively within capacity constraints and competing stakeholder needs

  • Driving measurable progress while safeguarding platform sustainability

Hard skills

  • Proven experience in digital product management, ideally in platform or advertising technology domains

  • Demonstrated ability to lead product initiatives from problem discovery through delivery

  • Experience with user discovery, product analytics, and iterative improvement

  • Confident in engaging with stakeholders and navigating trade-offs

Soft skills

  • Strategic – Sees the broader direction and connects daily decisions to long-term goals

  • Structured – Brings clarity and order to complex challenges

  • Decisive – Makes informed decisions and takes ownership

  • Curious & learning-oriented – Shows strong willingness and ability to learn, explore new technologies, and continuously develop skills

  • Driven – Demonstrates initiative, energy, and persistence in moving work forward and achieving results

We value curiosity, drive, and a willingness to learn. If this role excites you but you don’t meet every requirement, we still encourage you to apply. We evaluate candidates continuously, and the position may be filled before the application deadline.

title: Software Engineer, AI Agents
description:
Stories have the power to make the ordinary extraordinary. They help us think bigger, see beyond ourselves, and deepen our connection with others.

As one of the world's leading audiobook and e-book streaming platforms, Storytel brings unlimited listening to millions of users across 25 markets.

Driven by our purpose, "Leading the future of storytelling, we move the world through stories", Storytel Group inspires and entertains people around the world by blending innovation with tradition. We bring stories to life across various formats for everyone to discover. Anytime. Anywhere.

Ready for your next chapter? We're looking for an Agent Engineer to join our newly formed Agent Engineering team in Sweden!

About the Team

Agent Engineering is a new team at Storytel with a clear mission: find where AI agents can create real leverage across the organisation, and then build them. We work closely with business functions, understand their problems, and help them automate workflows using AI agents in a way that actually works reliably.

This isn't an R&D team and it isn't a consulting team. We sit at the intersection. When an agent is the right answer, we build one. When something else is the better solution, we say so. We build, test, evaluate, and iterate rather than ship things that only look like they work.

The team is small by design (2-3 people). We operate as a sibling team to Storytel's Platform Engineering team, who own the scalable agent infrastructure. We focus on the agents themselves: understanding the problem, designing the solution, integrating the right data and tools, and iterating until it reliably delivers.

If we get this right, we will fundamentally change how much of this organisation operates.

About the Role

This is a software development role, but also a bit more than that. We call it an Agent Engineer, this role bridges business and technology: understanding real problems with stakeholders, translating them into agent architectures, and doing the integration work to connect everything together.

As an Agent Engineer, you will work across the full lifecycle of agent development, from the first stakeholder conversation to a working, evaluated solution in production. You will be one of the first people to join this team, which means a high degree of ownership and a wide scope of work. You will work alongside our Agent Engineering Lead who also manage this team.

On any given week, you might be mapping out a workflow problem with a business team, designing the architecture of an agent, or troubleshooting an integration to get the right data flowing to the right place. Blockers are a given in this kind of work, so you will typically have several projects on the go and move between them as needed.

A key part of the role is building base agents that business teams can later adapt themselves, adjusting prompts, data sources, or configurations to tackle similar problems without starting from scratch each time.

About You

To be successful in this role, we believe that you have:

  • A strong engineering foundation. You have built real things, you understand what good architecture looks like, and you knew how to write software long before AI tools made it easier.

  • A practical instinct for the right tool. When a scripted solution is better than an LLM, you reach for the scripted solution. You understand the tradeoffs and can articulate them clearly.

  • Real experience with integration challenges. Getting the right data, with the right permissions, to the right place is often where the hard problems live. You have been there before.

  • The ability to translate across disciplines. You can sit with a business stakeholder, understand what is actually broken, and then turn around and have a completely different conversation with a platform engineer about API design.

  • Comfort with ambiguity and parallel workstreams. When you hit a wall, you work through it or find another route. You do not need a detailed brief to get started.

  • Pragmatic ambition. You would rather ship something that works and iterate than design something perfect that never ships. But pragmatic does not mean sloppy.

  • A willingness to speak up honestly. You say so when something is a bad idea, and you come with a better suggestion. You do not need to win every argument, but you are direct about your view.

  • At least 5 years of professional software engineering experience.

  • Hands-on experience with Python in a production context. Java is our primary backend language at Storytel, and Python is the language of choice for agent work.

  • Familiarity with Google Cloud Platform or similar cloud experience.

  • Prior exposure to agent frameworks or LLM tooling (we use Google ADK, but it is learnable if you have the foundations).

Join a world of stories

At Storytel, we're a team of creative story lovers who thrive on collaboration and new ideas. Our workplace is friendly, dynamic, and full of opportunities to experiment and make an impact. We believe in trust, flat hierarchies, and empowering you to grow with us.

Does this sound like your next story? Simply fill out the application form and share your CV or LinkedIn profile. Answer a few questions, and you're all set.

You have all of July to apply, we will start interviewing in August.

title: IT Operations Specialist
description:
Stories have the power to make the ordinary extraordinary. They help us think bigger, see beyond ourselves, and deepen our connection with others.

As one of the world's leading audiobook and e-book streaming platforms, Storytel brings unlimited listening to millions of users across 25 markets.

Driven by our purpose, "Leading the future of storytelling, we move the world through stories", Storytel Group inspires and entertains people around the world by blending innovation with tradition. We bring stories to life across various formats for everyone to discover. Anytime. Anywhere.

Ready for your next chapter? We're looking for an IT Operations Specialist to join our team in Stockholm!

About the Role

Do you want to architect, develop, and take technical ownership of modern cloud Digital Workplace platforms while remaining hands-on, managing daily operations and handling routine workplace IT tasks?

The IT Operations team is currently scaling our responsibilities and operations.
While Storytel’s core IT landscape is primarily built around Google Workspace and macOS, we are in an exciting phase where we are taking over the IT responsibility for companies within the group that mainly operate on Microsoft 365. We are looking for this role to act as the technical bridge for this expansion, which brings an exciting increase in technical complexity, multi-tenant environments, and global reach.

In this role, you will step into a vital and highly versatile position. While your primary focus will be acting as our internal driver for MDM and Microsoft 365 governance, this is a broad role where you will manage and work across a wide array of different systems, applications, processes, and projects. Simultaneously, you will remain hands-on, supporting the team in daily operations and taking ownership of Workplace IT.

Growth & Opportunities

For an ambitious candidate who successfully takes ownership and elevates our MDM and M365 environments, there are great opportunities to gradually shape the role and dive deeper into specialized infrastructure engineering and governance as our landscape evolves.

Core Responsibilities

  • MDM Evolution & Management: Take ownership of managing and developing our device management across our hybrid device fleet with Microsoft Intune and Jamf.
    You will architect, build, and maintain secure device configurations while also focusing on creating a great user experience with a distinct Storytel look and feel across all endpoints.

  • M365 & Identity Governance: Architect, configure, and manage our Microsoft 365 environments within a complex multi-tenant structure. These environments are tightly integrated with Okta as part of an advanced identity architecture, utilizing HRiS as a Source

  • SaaS System Administration: Daily administration, user lifecycle management, and optimization of various SaaS systems used and provided across the group.

  • IT Projects & Continuous Improvement: Actively lead and execute various internal IT projects. You will be a driving force behind onboarding new group environments and constantly leveling up our technical setup.

  • Vendor Management & Procurement: Manage relationships and contracts with external IT vendors, hardware suppliers, and SaaS providers. You will oversee software licensing, optimize procurement processes, and ensure we partner with the right external stakeholders.


Operational & Workplace Responsibilities

  • Office & AV technology: Driving the continuous improvement and development of our office technology and meeting rooms, while overseeing daily operations and support

  • IT-Equipment Management: Managing IT equipment lifecycle operations (procurement, inventory logistics, and on/offboarding setups) for a device fleet consisting primarily of MacBooks, alongside an increasing number of Windows devices.

  • Daily IT-support: Handling a broad variety of daily support requests from our end-users, both on-site and remote. Ranging from complex technical troubleshooting to routine, autopilot tasks

Requirements & Qualifications

  • Technical Experience: At least 3–5 years of experience working within IT operations, modern workplace management, or system administration.

  • MDM & M365 Expertise: Proven experience configuring and administering Microsoft Intune (device configuration, compliance policies, deployment) and managing Microsoft 365 environments. Experience with multi-tenant setups is a major plus.

  • Hands-on IT Support: Solid experience handling day-to-day workplace IT, end-user support, and hardware lifecycle management.

  • Advanced Workstation & OS Expertise: Deep technical knowledge of both Windows and macOS ecosystems, naturally becoming the go-to person in the team for anything related to computer management and troubleshooting.

  • Bonus Platform Knowledge: Experience with Okta, Google Workspace and Jamf is a strong advantage.

  • Language: Professional fluency in English, both written and spoken.


Who You Are

To thrive in this position, we are looking for a specific mindset and personality. We believe you recognize yourself in the following:

  • Autonomous & Driven: You don't wait for instructions. You identify what needs to be done, set your own agenda, and drive your initiatives to completion with high energy.

  • AI-Forward & Efficiency-Minded: You have a strong understanding of how to leverage AI to optimize your work. Actively finding ways to integrate AI into our systems to automate processes is critical to your success in this role.

  • Genuinely Tech-Savvy: You love technology and are motivated by continuous improvement. You take great pride in delivering high-quality, stable, and well-structured solutions.

  • People-Centric & Service-Minded: You are a genuine "people person" who excels at building relationships. You will interact extensively with users both at the office and in various other contexts, making a highly service-oriented mindset and strong interpersonal skills essential.

  • Humble & Versatile (Prestigeless): You move seamlessly between high-level cloud architecture and helping a colleague with an urgent hardware issue. You are ready to work broadly and jump in wherever the team needs you most.

  • Process-Minded: You have a natural ability to see the bigger picture and design structured, scalable processes rather than relying on ad-hoc fixes.

Location & Workplace

We operate on trust, meaning you have the freedom to manage your own calendar, shape your week, and adjust your daily working hours to fit your life.
Since a vital part of your role involves managing our physical office ecosystem and hands-on device troubleshooting, this role naturally relies on your physical presence at our Stockholm HQ on a daily basis. However, you will have autonomy over your daily calendar and how you pace your hours.

What We Offer

A role with high autonomy, immense learning potential, and the chance to leave your mark on a global IT infrastructure from day one. You will join a skilled team that values initiative, continuous learning, and having fun along the way.

Join a world of stories

At Storytel, we're a team of creative story lovers who thrive on collaboration and new ideas. Our workplace is friendly, dynamic, and full of opportunities to experiment and make an impact. We believe in trust, flat hierarchies, and empowering you to grow with us.

Does this sound like your next story? Simply fill out the application form and share your CV or LinkedIn profile. Please include your portfolio with your application. Answer a few questions, and you're all set.

title: Senior Platform Engineer
description:
Stories have the power to make the ordinary extraordinary. They help us think bigger, see beyond ourselves, and deepen our connection with others.

As one of the world's leading audiobook and e-book streaming platforms, Storytel brings unlimited listening to millions of users across 25 markets.

Driven by our purpose, "Leading the future of storytelling, we move the world through stories", Storytel Group inspires and entertains people around the world by blending innovation with tradition. We bring stories to life across various formats for everyone to discover. Anytime. Anywhere.

Ready for your next chapter? We're looking for a Senior Platform Engineer to join our Platform Engineering team!

About the Team

The Platform Engineering team focuses on setting up, operating and redefining observability, infrastructure, CI/CD, runtime, Machine Learning and AI agentic tooling at Storytel. We apply software engineering principles to accelerate software delivery and ensure that application development teams are productive in all aspects of the software delivery lifecycle.

We aim to design and build toolchains and workflows covering the operational necessities of the entire lifecycle of an application and to enable that as self-service for our teams. This means providing paved roads that make it easy for our application developers to focus on building a great experience for our users. We support the teams in making the most of our platform's capabilities and in providing best-practices knowledge.

Our team's expertise is very diverse, varying from cloud infrastructure, through security, to development tools, ML platform tooling, AI and more.

About the Role

Take the next step in your career as a Senior Platform Engineer at Storytel! At Storytel, engineers are viewed as leaders within the Individual Contributor roles, aiming to create impact and drive initiatives to bring our audio entertainment service to millions of users.

As a senior member of the Platform team, you will design, build and maintain the toolchains and workflows that help our teams manage the full life-cycle of their systems – including tools, libraries for our common languages, templates, automation, and configurations. You'll work across observability, deployment pipelines, quality assurance, availability, the runtime platform.

A key focus of this role is our ML platform capabilities. With AI and LLMs becoming a strategic part of how Storytel builds product experiences we need someone who can shape the paved road for ML workloads on Google Cloud and Vertex AI – making it easy for product teams to develop, deploy, and operate ML-powered features safely and reliably. Python is the lingua franca of this space and a key language for the role.

You'll also coach and unblock developers in their daily work, help them get the most out of the platform, and lead initiatives that improve developer experience across the organisation.

You will work with technologies including Metaflow, Argo Workflows, Argo Events, ArgoCD, Kargo, GitHub, GitHub Actions, Grafana, Prometheus, Kubernetes, Google Cloud Platform (including Vertex AI), Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, Atlantis), Fastly, and more.

About You

To be successful in this role, we believe that you have:

  • A platform engineering mindset. You understand that the job is about empowering other engineers to do their absolute best work, and you measure your success by their productivity and happiness.

  • A software engineer's perspective. You've been in the shoes of an application developer and you understand the friction, the trade-offs, and the long feedback loops engineers deal with every day.

  • Significant hands-on experience with ML on Google Cloud, and specifically Vertex AI – building, deploying, or operating ML workloads, pipelines, or platform capabilities that other teams build on top of. Strong Python skills in this context are expected.

  • A deep care for developer experience. You believe that good DX has a direct, positive impact on team morale, delivery speed, and product quality – and you can point to things you've built that prove it.

  • Strong long-term thinking on architecture. You weigh the maintenance cost of every decision and prefer boring, durable solutions over clever ones that someone else will have to live with.

  • Pragmatic ambition. You have high standards and a vision for where the platform should go, but you also understand the constraints of working in a small organisation and know how to ship value incrementally.

  • At least 5 years of professional software engineering experience, with solid hands-on development skills..

  • Strong experience with container technologies, Kubernetes, and distributed systems in production.

  • Strong experience with a major cloud provider – ideally Google Cloud Platform.

  • Experience working in DevEx-adjacent areas such as deployment pipelines, observability and monitoring, quality assurance, automation, self-service tooling, or runtime platforms.

  • An ability to communicate fluently in English (written and spoken) and to collaborate effectively across teams – this role does not work in isolation.

Bonus points for experience or interest in:

  • Building internal developer platforms (IDPs), golden paths, and self-service tooling

  • MLOps tooling and patterns – feature stores, model registries, evaluation pipelines, online/offline serving

  • Building AI agents – hands-on experience designing, building, or productionising agentic systems (e.g. with frameworks like ADK, LangGraph, or similar), including tool use, orchestration patterns, evaluation, and operating agents reliably in production

  • LLM application infrastructure – prompt management, evaluation, observability, guardrails

  • Infrastructure-as-code and configuration management at scale

  • Working with databases – MySQL, Postgres, etc.

  • Linux/Unix internals

Join a world of stories

At Storytel, we're a team of creative story lovers who thrive on collaboration and new ideas. Our workplace is friendly, dynamic, and full of opportunities to experiment and make an impact. We believe in trust, flat hierarchies, and empowering you to grow with us.

title: Client Advisor Holistic Advice (Private) - Visby
description:
Swedbank arbetar för att skapa en trygg och hållbar ekonomi för våra kunder. Med hög tillgänglighet, stort engagemang och affärsfokus kan du vara med att forma fram framtidens kundmöten. Tillsammans med kollegor skapar vi en attraktiv och positiv arbetsplats.

Hos oss på Swedbank har du en möjlighet att:

  • Bidra som en central del i ett engagerat team där vi tillsammans arbetar för att skapa långsiktiga kundrelationer genom rådgivning, försäljning och engagemang i kundens ekonomi

  • Möta kunder i både fysiska möten på det lokala kontoret och i digitala rådgivningssamtal med kunder från hela landet – där varje möte präglas av lyhördhet, professionalism och hög servicekänsla

  • Arbeta proaktivt med Swedbanks breda produktutbud, med särskilt fokus på bolån, och vägleda kunder mot trygga och hållbara finansiella beslut som stärker deras långsiktiga finansiella hälsa

  • Säkerställa att varje kundmöte, oavsett kanal, håller hög kvalitet och är behovsbaserat – med målet att skapa värde, förtroende och en positiv kundupplevelse i varje kontakt

  • Samarbeta nära kollegor och specialister för att hitta de bästa lösningarna för kunden, driva försäljning på ett ansvarsfullt sätt samt aktivt bidra till kontorets gemensamma mål och framgång

I denna roll behöver du: 

  • Swedsec-rådgivarlicens, Bolånelicens och IDD (försäkringsdistributionsrätt) som grund för att kunna ge kvalificerad rådgivning och säkerställa hög regelefterlevnad

  • Driv och affärsfokus med förmåga att identifiera kunders behov och omvandla dem till hållbara finansiella lösningar – oavsett om mötet sker fysiskt, digitalt eller via telefon

  • Erfarenhet av att genomföra både fysiska och digitala rådgivningsmöten där du skapar förtroende, lyssnar in kundens situation och vägleder till rätt beslut

  • Förmåga att arbeta målinriktat med försäljning och resultat, samtidigt som du sätter kundnöjdhet och långsiktiga relationer i första rummet

  • En stark laganda där du aktivt bidrar till teamets gemensamma mål, delar med dig av kunskap och stöttar kollegor i vardagen

  • Ett lyhört, pedagogiskt och relationsskapande arbetssätt som bygger förtroende och trygghet i alla kundkontakter

  • En genuin vilja att kontinuerligt utvecklas, hålla dig uppdaterad om bankens produkter, marknadstrender och rådgivningsmetoder för att alltid kunna ge bästa möjliga kundvärde

Hos oss kan du uppleva:

  • Personlig och professionell utveckling genom självledarskap och kontinuerlig utveckling.

  • Meningsfullt arbete som positivt påverkar vår arbetsplats, våra kunder och samhället.

  • En öppen och samarbetsinriktad kultur som uppmuntrar tvärfunktionellt teamarbete och erbjuder nätverksmöjligheter.

  • En stöttande och inkluderande miljö som främjar en balanserad och hållbar arbetslivssituation, med flexibla arbetsförhållanden när det passar rollen.

  • Förmåner såsom vårt erbjudande för bankprodukter för anställda, tjänstepensionsplan, aktiebaserade belöningsprogram Eken, och frivillig gruppförsäkring.


"Bli en del av vårt team och...

Inled din utvecklingsresa inom våra kundmötande tjänster. Du får jobba i direkt kundkontakt och hjälpa människor nå lösningar på sina ärenden. Du är Swedbanks ansikte utåt och en oerhört viktig del av vår verksamhet. Vi tror att du kan vara dig själv och samtidigt utvecklas till en framgångsrik kundrådgivare. Om du känner igen dig i denna beskrivning är vi mycket intresserade av dig. Vi värnar om ditt välmående och erbjuder en hållbar arbetsmiljö. På Swedbank är medarbetarna vår största tillgång. Vi har en kultur som bygger på respekt, inkludering och öppenhet, där varje medarbetares röst är viktig. Vi lever bankens värderingar; Öppen, Enkel och Omtänksam”. Daniel Björding, din framtida chef

Vi ser fram emot din ansökan senast den 2026-08-15. 

Placeringsort: Visby

Rekryterande chef: Daniel Björding, 0498-40 44 57

Vänligen observera att rekryteringsarbetet kan ta lite längre tid än normalt då det är sommarsemester.

Vi vill göra dig uppmärksam på att bakgrundskontroll och drogtest kan komma att genomföras för denna roll om du går vidare i processen.

Vi har gjort vårt medieval för rekrytering och undanber oss därför kontakt med annonssäljare eller säljare av andra rekryteringstjänster.

Swedbank är en inkluderande arbetsgivare och diskriminerar ingen utifrån kön, ålder, sexuell läggning eller sexuell identitet, etnicitet, religion eller funktionsnedsättning - alla är välkomna.
